description: Manages and retrieves application-wide configuration settings, providing access to various parameters and values that govern the system's behavior.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current application-wide configuration settings. This endpoint provides access to various parameters and values that govern the behavior and appearance of the system.
example_uses: How do I get the current application configuration?
Show me all the system settings.
Can you retrieve the configuration details for the application?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch the global configuration settings for the application, such as API keys, feature flags, or environmental variables.
